reasons: single national flag IS the whole graphic (strong single focal point)
ragged / torn / clawed edges are the defining trait
distressed, worn, weathered texture over the flag
bold scale, centred, generous negative space on the garment
reads at a glance; flag stays recognisable despite the wear

provenance.notes: Two sub-styles observed: (1) full-colour flag with brush/torn edges (achievable: edgeTear + distress); (2) mono tattered flag (achievable: edgeTear + monoInk + heavy distress). A THIRD 'ripped-through-fabric' look (flag visible through a claw gash in the shirt) needs a fabric-tear mask the renderer does not have yet.
